This theory is better than anything I could have come up with.

However, I think Aviendha's vision is compelling evidence that Rand has to deal with the Seanchan before he goes to Shayol Ghul. The people of the world need to present a united front to effectively combat the shadow, and currently the Seanchan are weakening that united front, by attacking the White Tower, and trying to conquer the entire continent.

This is why Rand was unable to negotiate a truce with the Seanchan. Their practice of collaring saidar channelers was a deal breaker during Rand's meeting with Tuon. Somehow, Rand will have to break them of this practice, and force their loyalty to him, just as he has allied almost all other nations and peoples to him.

I don't know whether Rand will do this himself, or another character (such as Mat, the Prince of Ravens now) will be the one to break them.
